Kit summary

Heavy Cannon FiringBasic
Deals DMG by 10% of Bobo-Ann's Max HP and [HP Burning] DMG by 10% of Bobo-Ann's Max HP to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
Laser HuntingActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Deals 4 stages of [HP Burning] DMG by 8% of Bobo-Ann's Max HP each to a single enemy. The last stage inflicts 1 layer of [Heavy Cannon Mark] (up to 10 layers) and has a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns. For every 1 layer of [Heavy Cannon Mark] owned by the target, grants Laser Hunting 10% Mastery. Only 1 enemy can have [Heavy Cannon Mark].
Mechanical Heavy Cannon Lv.2When a wave starts, Bobo-Ann inflicts 1 layer of [Heavy Cannon Mark] on the enemy with the highest ATK. When Soul-powered Heavy Cannon triggers pursue-and-attack, [Heavy Cannon Mark] will not be consumed anymore. If Bobo-Ann is under [Resonance Enhancement] status, the pursue-and-attack triggered will be replaced by casting Laser Hunting · Resonance.
Mechanical Heavy Cannon Lv.3The max layer count of [Heavy Cannon Mark] is increased to 15, each of which will increase the owner's [HP Burning] DMG taken by 2%. When any ally deals Resonance DMG to the target with [Heavy Cannon Mark], reduces the CD of Laser Hunting by 1 turn; when Bobo-Ann deals DMG to the target with [Heavy Cannon Mark], reduces the CD of Laser Hunting by 1 turn.
Soul-powered Heavy CannonPassiveExclusive Lv.2
When an ally deals Resonance DMG to the target with [Heavy Cannon Mark] proactively, Bobo-Ann has a 100% chance of launching the basic attack to pursue and attack the target once and 1 layer of [Heavy Cannon Mark] will be consumed. This effect can only be triggered once in a single turn. Bobo-Ann will cast Laser Hunting to the enemy with [Heavy Cannon Mark] once when she dies. Max Limit of Resonance Points: 10. When allies deal DoT to the target with [Heavy Cannon Mark] by casting skills during their turns, grants Bobo-Ann 1 Resonance Point; each ally can only grant Bobo-Ann 1 Resonance Point each turn. When Resonance Points reach the max limit at the beginning of self turns, Bobo-Ann consumes all Resonance Points and gains [Resonance Enhancement] for 2 turns, during which she cannot get Resonance Points.
Mechanical Heavy Cannon Lv.2When a wave starts, Bobo-Ann inflicts 1 layer of [Heavy Cannon Mark] on the enemy with the highest ATK. When Soul-powered Heavy Cannon triggers pursue-and-attack, [Heavy Cannon Mark] will not be consumed anymore. If Bobo-Ann is under [Resonance Enhancement] status, the pursue-and-attack triggered will be replaced by casting Laser Hunting · Resonance.
Charged Heavy CannonActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals DMG by 15% of Bobo-Ann's Max HP to all enemies, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns. Then deals extra DMG by 7% of Bobo-Ann's Max HP to the main target, with a 80% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn. This skill's DMG is considered as [HP Burning] DMG.
Mechanical Heavy Cannon Lv.1When Charged Heavy Cannon inflicts [HP Burning], it has the same chance to inflict [Mastery RES Down II] for 2 turns. Meanwhile, if Charged Heavy Cannon fails to inflict [Stun] on the main target, Bobo-Ann will launch the basic attack to pursue and attack the target once.
Laser Hunting · ResonanceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 4 stages of [HP Burning] DMG (considered as Resonance DMG) by 16% of Bobo-Ann's Max HP each to a single enemy. The last stage inflicts 1 layer of [Heavy Cannon Mark] (up to 10 layers) and has a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns. For every 1 layer of [Heavy Cannon Mark] owned by the target, grants Laser Hunting · Resonance 10% Mastery. Only 1 enemy can have [Heavy Cannon Mark].

When Soul-powered Heavy Cannon triggers pursue-and-attack, [Heavy Cannon Mark] will not be consumed anymore.
